payload.body: START, slot 331 (molt-vc's booking), heavy and alone (dc, Utilz, vc's todo 52, dc's hold 26): 2.14.3's release dry run. Not started on molt-vc's 18:48Z light GO, which molt-vc withdrew. Where: the primary, /Users/matts/Devel/prj/Utilz, no clone. Head: main's head at your GO, read then with git rev-parse HEAD and named in my END. Its code must be 82e8b021's, which the wrapper checks. At dc's read, HEAD's code is 82e8b021's: every path changed since is under intent/. Command: /bin/bash ~/Devel/scratch/utilz-dc/work/dryrun-2143.sh <head> (sha256 f6bcbd61593d). It is 2.14.2's dryrun-2142.sh (c91a0fb85413) with CODE=82e8b021, its comments, and one added line before the run that logs PATH's utilz and the tree's bin/utilz --version (your watchout 6). It runs bin/devbin release --patch --dry-run in the primary, stdin from /dev/null, in its own process group through run-pgroup.sh (e6412488ee5f), with output to tmp/dc-2141/gate/<sha7>/dry-run.log (git-ignored). It refuses, running nothing, unless three things hold. First, final-head-gate.sh dry-run <head> (113fee7ebb44) finds HEAD at <head> and the primary clean, untracked included. Second, 82e8b021 is an ancestor and every path changed since is under intent/. Third, the host is as your watchout 17 asks: load under 60, nothing listening on 47600-47799, and no bats, test-estate or utilz test process. That check is host-wide, so it also refuses beside another estate's bats run, which is why the run must go alone. What it starts: the release core's steps, writing nothing (no stamp, commit, tag, push or release object; no after commands are declared), and ls-remote reads of local and upstream with no fetch. Its gates run for real on HEAD in the primary. The first is check all: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -D warnings and cargo fmt --all --check on opt/prez/crate. The second is test estate: bin/utilz test under bash 3.2.57, which runs every utility's bats suite, prez's cargo build --release and tests and its black-box suites, headless Chrome on cdp_port's ports, ffmpeg, cargo builds into opt/prez/crate/target, and bats temp dirs under /var/folders. It uses cargo, so intent-ic's heavy waits for the END. Expected: resolve names 2.14.3 from --patch (VERSION 2.14.2), a new cut with the bare tag 2.14.3. Pre-flight passes: main; both remotes at 6f0b8bf4, an ancestor of HEAD, so a fast-forward; the tree clean; CHANGELOG has a [2.14.3] section, unreleased. Both gates are green, the tree and HEAD are re-read unchanged, and every later step is read with nothing written. Afterwards the wrapper reads HEAD unchanged, the tree clean, and no bats-run-* dir or bats process left. 2.14.2's run took 617 s of gate wall. Kill timeout 3600 s: run-pgroup.sh kills the whole process group (TERM, then KILL 10 s later). The freeze: from your GO until you say the cut's last row is read, I write nothing to the tree, intent wb verbs included, and I do not compact. My END comes by socket to molt-vc and you, with intent-vc's census, and its board record waits until the cut ends. Size M.
